extraction.name: RoboBench
extraction.description: A comprehensive evaluation benchmark for multimodal large language models as embodied brains
extraction.creator: Yulin Luo, Chun-Kai Fan, Menghang Dong, Jiayu Shi, Mengdi Zhao, Bo-Wen Zhang, Cheng Chi, Jiaming Liu, Gaole Dai, Rongyu Zhang, Ruichuan An, Kun Wu, Zhengping Che, Shaoxuan Xie, Guocai Yao, Zhongxia Zhao, Pengwei Wang, Guang Liu, Zhongyuan Wang, Tiejun Huang, Shanghang Zhang
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset combines large-scale real-world robotic datasets with curated in-house collection, drawing from open-source and in-house robotic data.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Physical data collection, Software Collection, Web Scraping, User-generated content data
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The dataset is constructed from open-source robotic data and in-house collection.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: The dataset is annotated with MLLM- and human-provided annotations.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The benchmark aims to advance robotic intelligence and provide insights for developing more robust and generalizable embodied intelligence.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The benchmark reveals several critical limitations in current MLLMs, including difficulties with implicit instruction comprehension, spatiotemporal reasoning, cross-scenario planning, fine-grained affordance understanding, and execution failure diagnosis.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The benchmark has limitations in terms of data generalization limits and quality issues. Current MLLMs exhibit only superficial embodied reasoning and world-modeling capabilities.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The benchmark can be used for Training, Testing, Validation, and Fine Tuning of multimodal large language models as embodied brains.
